source.snippet: Ask HN: Anyone used SERPSpur as an alternative to Ahrefs and SEMrush? 'as I see the old giants are replaced by new generation tools which seems faster and more affordable, please suggest if anyone used.' — 3 points, 2 comments.

problem_statement: SEO professionals and small business owners find Ahrefs and SEMrush too expensive and slow, and are actively seeking faster, more affordable alternatives — signaling willingness to switch and pay for the right tool.
target_segment: SEO professionals, digital marketers, and small business owners currently paying for Ahrefs/SEMrush subscriptions
notes: Buyer signal: poster is actively evaluating paid alternatives to Ahrefs/SEMrush, implying they currently pay or budget for such tools. Market is well-established with known price pain. Signal is weak (single post, low engagement) but buyer intent is clear.
